observed.detail: Near-central tall cab with a gently curved overhanging roof; side door with a framed window and a slim second window, a front window toward the front hood.
Two low hoods of comparable length and the same nominal width either side of the cab; the front hood carries louvre panels and a slatted radiator, the rear hood plain inspection panels.
One short exhaust on the front hood only.
Round lamps at the outer upper hood corners and on the cab roof ends, small red marker lights on the cab.
Straight rectangular bright red underframe with parallel sides, end skirts, a central step, buffers and couplers; two visible red disc wheels with steel tyres on two axles.
Charcoal body, vivid red underframe, opaque blue glass with diagonal highlights.
